lines.text: Shh. They're walking past us.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Hey! Over here!
Shh! Shhhhh!

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Haha, they're already gone.
As the guard's footsteps grow fainter,
I relax for a moment and catch my breath.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Oh, they're coming back.
Tsk.
I pose again.
... Sin and I are hiding behind a statue of Mustang.
The life-size statue is striking a rather dramatic pose,
and we're holding the same pose behind it.
Thankfully, Mustang's stature is big enough that if we stand perfectly still behind it, matching its pose...
Footsteps approach...
It's impossible to spot us from the front.
The guard walks by, and I can finally relax again.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Haha, this pose is so embarrassing and hard to hold.
The road to entertainment is not an easy one.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Look up there.
Sin points up at the ceiling
where Guilty hangs with her fingers dug into it.
... That's not something just anyone can do.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Yeah. Only Guilty can pull off something like that.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: And look over there, too.
I look in the direction that Sin is pointing.
At first glance, it's an ordinary flower bed.
*Ripple*
... The flower bed seems to warp strangely. It was barely noticeable, but I definitely saw it.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: The Elysion Nikkes are hiding there.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: They're using a camouflage fabric.
The flower bed distorts again,
and the high heels of a bunny girl peeks out from its edge.
Wow, that's so unfair. Isn't this way too stacked in Elysion's favor?

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: I mean, the High-Tech Butt Wrestling was in our favor, too. That's just how it is.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Oh, they're coming again. Pose, pose.
I'm beat.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Why are you here, anyway? You're not even a participant.
... Wait, you're right.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Haha, this is fun.
We pose together, and the guard walks past the Mustang statue.

lines.speaker: mustang_statue
lines.text: Eeentertainment!!
Suddenly, a loud voice rings out from the statue.
Uh oh...!
The guard turns around and approaches us.
Please, please just walk past us...

lines.speaker: mustang_statue
lines.text: Eeentertainment!!
I hear them running. We have to run.
Sin! Run...!

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Here!
At that moment, Sin tosses the coin she's holding.
The coin goes flying into the flower bed, hitting the camouflage fabric.
*Rustle*
With the sound of paper being folded, the fabric mimicking the flower bed crumples.
The two bunny girls from Elysion are revealed.
Visibly startled, the two stare at the security guard, who stares back at them.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Haha, now's our chance. Let's get out of here.
You really are evil, you know that?

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Thanks for the compliment.
*Beep, beep, beep!*
As we sneak away, an alarm suddenly sounds.
Water begins to rain down from the ceiling.
The fire sprinklers? Why did they suddenly go off...?!

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Hmm... I guess they're just blatantly targeting us now.
Everyone looks up at the activated sprinkler,
only to find Guilty hanging from the ceiling next to it.

lines.speaker: guilty_b
lines.text: Oh... I've been found...
*Bang! Bang! Bang!*
A burst of gunfire echoes across the hall. Guilty drops from the ceiling onto the roof of the bar and makes a run for it.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: They're openly giving away our position. What a petty move.
How infuriating.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Guilty and I should be fine.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Those guards are trained, but they're somewhere between amateurs and professionals in terms of skill.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: We'll have no problem shaking them off.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Mana and Flora, on the other hand...
Mana laments her current predicament.
She hates herself for running around Coin Rush, desperately searching for somewhere to hide in a bunny girl outfit she was forced to wear.
She hates herself for squeezing herself into a hiding spot she finally managed to find.
She hates herself for feeling relieved when the guards walk past her.
And she hated herself for fleeing in fright not a moment later, when a spotlight suddenly shines down on her.
She looks for a hiding spot, hides, breathes a sigh of relief, gets caught by a spotlight, and runs away.

She looks for another hiding spot, hides, breathes a sigh of relief, gets caught by a spotlight, and runs away again, only to look for a hiding spot, hide, breathe a sigh of relief, get caught by a spotlight, and run away.
Repeating this process six times, Mana's self-loathing has reached critical levels.
In the end, Mana gives up.
The nervous guard can't believe his eyes for a moment.
Something lurks in the shadows by the wall. For a moment, he thinks it's a ghost.
There's something deeply unsettling about the sight of a human-shaped figure crouching motionlessly, staring at the dark wall.
He takes a closer look at the figure and recognizes her as Mana from Plan C.
The infamous Plan C. The nervous guard gulps before slowly approaching, his gun trained on her.
There's no way she hasn't sensed his presence or heard his footsteps.
Even so, Mana remains completely still.
The nervous guard feels sweat trickling down his face.
What's going on? What is she scheming? Is it really safe to keep approaching her like this? Should I just take the shot now?
But what if she's trying to draw my fire? What if this is a trap?
The nervous guard breathes shakily as he approaches Mana.
Suddenly, Mana gets up.

lines.speaker: tenseguard
lines.text: Hurk...!
Mana slowly turns around and glares at the nervous guard.

lines.speaker: tenseguard
lines.text: H-hands up...! I said hands up!
There's no need for him to warn her. The nervous guard is the seeker, and all he has to do is fire his suppression rounds at any participants he finds.
Despite that, the nervous guard instinctively shouts at Mana,

lines.speaker: tenseguard
lines.text: What are you plotting?! What the hell are you up to?!
Mana grabs the bottle strapped to her waist.
The nervous guard tenses up even more. He senses that she's about to pull out her trump card.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: ... Do you know what's in this bottle?
What is she up to? Why is she talking to me?
Oh... that must be it.
It's that classic trope where someone rattles off the details of their ultimate move before using it.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: I call it "Mana Potion." I mixed this drink myself.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: It's for the hardest of days, when I don't want to think about anything and everything...

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: I came up with this specifically so I can pass out immediately and sleep like the dead after drinking it.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: That's exactly how I feel right now.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: I'm having a really hard day, and I don't want to think about anything anymore.
*Gulp, gulp, gulp*
Mana chugs the entire bottle.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: ... Ugh.
She collapses to the floor like a robot that suddenly lost power.
She doesn't move an inch.
The nervous guard stares intently at Mana's lifeless form.
A short moment later, he places his hand on his earpiece.

lines.speaker: tenseguard
lines.text: M-Mana of Plan C has been caught.
Mana of Plan C...
is eliminated.
The dutiful guard hesitates.
He doesn't know how to react to the sight of Flora sitting in the middle of a field of flowers that has bloomed across the floor.
Peacefully surrounded by flowers, Flora gazes at the dutiful guard, unfazed.

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: ... Flora of Plan C has been found.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Oh my, how did you find me?

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Where better to hide a flower than in a flower bed? I'm impressed you managed to find a flower like me hidden among them.

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: Engaging and neutralizing.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Are you sure about that?

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: It'll be fine if your bullet hits its target, but if you miss...

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: These poor flowers will be wounded and they'll wither away.

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: I won't miss at this range.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Is that so? I plan on dodging as best I can.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Then these freshly bloomed little ones are sure to wither away.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: If you come closer, you'll increase your chances of hitting me.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: But these poor little ones, freshly bloomed, will be trampled under your combat boots.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Then they'll wither away.
The dutiful guard places his finger on the trigger.
She is clearly bluffing. He will take down Flora of Plan C at this very moment.
However, the dutiful guard suddenly recalls a distant memory.

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: A flower shop? You want to grow fresh flowers and sell them?

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: Oh... you got me. Yeah, I love flowers.

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: I guess... I've liked them ever since I was a child. They're pretty.

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: Yeah. When we get married, let's open a flower shop.

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: Though growing fresh flowers might be unrealistic, haha.

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: Yeah. It's a promise. Let's open a flower shop.

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: ... I love you too.
Memories of a beautiful past stir something deep within the dutiful guard.
A young man with a love of flowers, and the woman he had promised a future with.
Although their relationship ended when he cheated on her, those memories remained a beautiful part of his past.

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: I... I can't shoot.
The dutiful guard lowers his gun.
*Beep!*
The whistle blows, signaling the end of the round.
The dutiful guard holds Flora's gaze.

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: ... May I take a flower?

lines.speaker: diligentguard
lines.text: I'd like to spend some time reminiscing.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Yes, of course.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: They're artificial flowers, but they're still beautiful.
